history_family: original 33 labelled AA histories, 10 boundary orbits
weight_class: w_o >= 0, sum w_o=1; labelled weights w_o/m_o; invariant under S2(input) x S2(output), independent of lambda and integration variables
strict_positive_class: all w_o>0; infimum equals the closed-simplex minimum by continuity; no positive floor imposed
fixed: all prior E6,F6 states, V Grams, phases, lambda endpoints and uniform-labelled reference Hessian; no moving reference or complex gravity normalization
secondary_objective: separate min_w of the entire atom-to-positive 4x2 block
proof_strategy: exact incoming-density factorization; convex spectral norm; rational primal weights for upper bound and normalized rational left/right trial vectors for global separating lower bound, all evaluated with Arb and inherited quadrature tails
optimization_role: candidate discovery only, never a certificate
connected_mean: keep original decomposition where Z(w)!=0; do not infer a connected lower bound from a difference-block lower bound; include vertex controls
extra_weight_restrictions: NONE; no gluing or counting law beyond inherited boundary symmetry is imposed

quadrature.tails: inherited analytic Bernstein-ellipse bounds, checked by replay

targets.positive_lower_bound: certify if possible, otherwise construct exact full-block cancellation or state unresolved

excluded: new histories or enlarged test spaces
